selection_rule: Lowest mean VALIDATION delay across all run seeds; earlier checkpoint tie-break
ablation_rule: Retrain with same seeds/budget; evaluate at full-policy selected budget on VALIDATION

promotion_rule.primary: Simultaneous paired total-delay CI upper < 0 versus all three baselines
promotion_rule.subgroups: Zero-margin non-regression CI upper <= 0 on critical metrics and every final scenario
promotion_rule.invariants: All must pass; inconclusive means no promotion
promotion_rule.production: Keep existing heuristic configuration; no automatic deployment

test_rule: Freeze selection/checkpoint hashes; consume final suite once; interrupted identical jobs can resume
limitation: Bounded synthetic study, 12 episodes/run, no convergence or real-road claim
